entities.summary: Plácido Rodríguez C.M.F. is a Mexican-born American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Lubbock in Texas from 1994 to 2015 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of San Antonio in Texas from 1983 to 1994. he is a member of the Missionary Sons of the Immaculate Heart of Mary (Claretians).

entities.summary: Plácido Rodríguez C.M.F. is a Mexican-born American prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Lubbock in Texas from 1994 to 2015 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of San Antonio in Texas from 1983 to 1994. he is a member of the Missionary Sons of the Immaculate Heart of Mary (Claretians).
